newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks edge down at end in dull trading.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks edge down at end in dull trading.

text.p: Pakistani stocks edged down at close on Wednesday amid thin trading as sentiment remained weak before the 1997/98 (July-June) budget due in June, dealers said.

"There is little interest from investors and trading volume has shrunk sharply," a dealer said. "The country's weak economic fundamentals have dissuaded investors and they wait for the budget for a clearer picture on economic front."
The Karachi Stock Exchange's 100-share index fell 0.58 points, or 0.04 percent, to end at 1,512.47. Nishat Mills fell 1.50 rupees to 20.35. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
